headline: From a crowded class library to a validated three-week balance plan
overview: Nadia narrows the public teacher library to balance work, switches from individual classes to programs, inspects the progression, then carries the structured program into Yoga Quest's importer for review.
payoff: She reaches a real import preview confirming the complete eight-session program, 33 exercises, and six workouts before anything is saved.

scenes.title: Nadia starts with the whole teacher library
scenes.narrative: Tomorrow's class needs balance work, but Nadia does not want to assemble it from memory. The public library gives her duration, level, focus, and format before she commits to anything.
frameCaptions: Nadia starts with the whole teacher library

scenes.title: She names the teaching need, not a pose
scenes.narrative: Typing **balance** reduces the class inventory to relevant sessions. She can compare foundations, supported practice, and longer flows without knowing the library's exact titles.
frameCaptions: She names the teaching need, not a pose

scenes.title: She switches from sessions to progression
scenes.narrative: Nadia needs a sequence that develops over time, not one isolated class. The Programs tab turns the same intent into multi-week paths with session counts and pacing.
frameCaptions: She switches from sessions to progression

scenes.title: The balance plan explains its promise
scenes.narrative: The detail view names the three-week goal, the eight-session cadence, and the role of wall and chair support. Nadia can judge whether the plan fits her group before looking at individual days.
frameCaptions: The balance plan explains its promise

scenes.title: She checks how the challenge actually grows
scenes.narrative: The path moves from supports and an easy step-down to standing foundations, hinges, recovery, and a final integrated flow. Rest days are part of the plan rather than missing content.
frameCaptions: She checks how the challenge actually grows

scenes.title: The copied plan lands in the real importer
scenes.narrative: Nadia moves the generated JSON into the product's own import surface. The interface explains that this draft stays in the tab and can be reviewed before it changes her library.
frameCaptions: The copied plan lands in the real importer
scenes.action: Opened JSON import mode and pasted the copied program payload.

scenes.title: The product validates the complete teaching plan
scenes.narrative: The importer confirms **33 exercises · 6 workouts · 1 program** and names the eight-session balance path. Nadia can inspect the first session and every downstream workout before deciding whether to save it.
frameCaptions: The product validates the complete teaching plan
scenes.action: Clicked "Preview import" and observed the parsed program summary.
